name: Presse-papiers (images)
cmd: sh -c 'pgrep -f "wl-paste --type image" >/dev/null || exec wl-paste --type image --watch cliphist store'

name: Agent Polkit
cmd: sh -c '/usr/bin/pgrep -x polkit-kde-authentication-agent-1 >/dev/null && exit 0; for agent in /usr/lib/polkit-kde-authentication-agent-1 /usr/libexec/lxqt-policykit-agent /usr/lib/hyprpolkitagent/hyprpolkitagent; do if [ -x "$agent" ]; then exec "$agent"; fi; done'

name: Historique du presse-papiers
cmd: sh -c '/usr/bin/pgrep -f "cliphist store" >/dev/null || exec wl-paste --watch cliphist store'
